reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes larger particles will increase thickness; in thermal spray, larger particles often melt less completely, leading to lower deposition efficiency and potentially thinner, more porous coatings, contradicting established knowledge.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative experiment with clear measurements and a specific falsification criterion (30% thickness increase, oxidation, adhesion) is well-defined and feasible.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a flawed premise; a researcher would be misled by the proposed mechanism and likely waste effort on a counterproductive intervention.
